qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in relevant disciplines or B.Tech/BE with required marks and valid GATE score.
qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow: Master’s degree level in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Chemical Engineering/Technology, Physics, Applied Physics, Solid State Physics/Technology/Electronic Materials/Materials, Nanotechnology, Materials Science/Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Electrical, VLSI/Microelectronics, Instrumentation Engineering Technology with first class (minimum 65% marks or 7.0 CPI) in M.Tech./ME/MS with GATE/NET qualifications and first class (minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CPI) in B.Tech./BE, 12th and 10th class. Or B.Tech./BE in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Nanotechnology, Materials Science/Engineering, and Engineering Physics with 75% marks or 8.0 CPI in B.Tech./BE from institutes other than IITs/IISc and 7.0 CPI in B.Tech. from IITs and IISc with valid GATE score and first class (minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CPI) in 12th and 10th class. Working/research experience in design, fabrication, testing, packaging, memory devices, RRAM/Artificial Neurons, optoelectronic devices given preference.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 37,000/- per month for first two years followed by Rs. 42,000/- per month in third year

Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) for a temporary research position in the Department of Electrical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in IIT Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The position offered is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under an ANRF funded project. Eligible candidates holding relevant master's or bachelor's degrees can apply.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Patna JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your complete application via email is 30 October 2026. Candidates must ensure applications reach before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or stipend for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, which will be increased to Rs. 42,000/- per month in the third year.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in relevant engineering or science disciplines with GATE/NET or a B.Tech/BE degree with required marks and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit to apply for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years for BE/B.Tech/M.Sc candidates and 32 years for ME/M.Tech/MS candidates, with relaxations as per GoI rules.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply by sending their scanned application form, academic CV, and supporting self-attested documents via email to the designated project investigators.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interview take place for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The online interview for shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 5 November 2026, following the shortlist announcement on 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of IIT Patna?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the institute at www.iitp.ac.in to find more details regarding the notification, updates, and results.
